id: 26_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 1200W - Unboxing and First Use
title: 手持式激光焊接机开箱与首次使用（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/26_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 1200W - Unboxing and First Use.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/26_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder 1200W - Unboxing and First Use（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 看开箱提示：先开盖，再侧拉外箱
points.K2: 先取焊枪，再取泡沫和主机
points.K3: 认识主机和送丝机的部件
points.K4: 主机留散热间隙，锁定脚轮
points.K8: 电源要求：单独支路，必须接地
points.K9: 硬接线由专业电工完成
points.K14: 首次开机：看安全培训再解锁
points.K20: 引丝：不松手，剪弯头，穿丝
points.K23: 送丝管装到焊枪，微调焊丝
points.K25: 装流量计，先通气调流量
points.K26: 工件放金属底座，感应线别夹焊枪
points.K29: 先点焊后连续焊，稳住不下压
points.K30: 焊后高温别碰，关闭使能
points.K32: 激光切割：换嘴、换表、查红点
points.K34: 镜片脏了：干净环境里处理
points.K36: 换镜片不碰玻璃，方向装对

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个大包装箱旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a large blank cardboard shipping box on a wooden pallet and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲手持激光焊接机的开箱和首次使用。
overlay: 手持式激光焊接机开箱与首次使用

shots.scene: 开箱、安装、首次使用、维护四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an opened box, a wrench, a welding gun with a spark, and a gear with a cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 开箱、安装、首次使用、维护，四部分。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着化纤运动服、披着长发，兴冲冲拆箱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing a shiny synthetic sports jacket and with long loose hair, eagerly starts tearing open the box.
shots.narration: 新焊接机到了，阿杰穿着运动服就来拆箱。

shots.scene: 老李拦住他，指指他的衣服、头发和拖鞋
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops him and points at his synthetic jacket, loose hair and open slippers.
shots.narration: 老李摇头：这身打扮，可不适合干这个。

shots.scene: 老李把一套工作服、发帽和劳保鞋递给阿杰
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer hands the young male student a cotton work suit, a hair cap and safety boots.
shots.narration: 先换好衣服鞋子，我们一步一步来。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在衣架前，一边是棉质工作服，一边是化纤外套
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between a cotton work suit with a green check and a shiny synthetic jacket with a red X.
shots.narration: 焊接和切割会溅出火花。

shots.scene: 火花落在化纤布上熔成一个洞，旁边皮肤图标发红
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a spark landing on synthetic fabric and melting a hole, with a reddened skin icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 化纤衣服遇火花会熔化，粘在皮肤上。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿上阻燃工作服，系好领口
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on a flame-resistant cotton work suit and buttons the collar.
shots.narration: 穿阻燃或纯棉工作服，扣好领口。

shots.scene: 阿杰把长发扎起，塞进发帽
shots.prompt_en: The young male student ties up his long hair and tucks it into a work cap.
shots.narration: 长发要束起来，塞进帽子。

shots.scene: 头发和袖口靠近转动的焊丝盘，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of loose hair and a loose sleeve near a spinning wire spool and drive rollers, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝轮和焊丝盘会转，可能卷进头发衣角。

shots.scene: 阿杰扣紧袖口，摘下围巾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student fastens his sleeve cuffs and takes off a scarf.
shots.narration: 袖口扎紧，围巾挂绳都摘掉。

shots.scene: 阿杰换上包头的劳保鞋，拖鞋被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on toe-capped safety boots; a pair of slippers beside him is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 脚上换成防砸防烫的劳保鞋。

shots.scene: 焊丝盘掉在脚边、熔渣落在地上的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a heavy wire spool dropping near a foot and hot slag drops on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 搬设备、换焊丝盘可能砸脚，熔渣会烫脚。

shots.section_title: 看开箱提示：先开盖，再侧拉外箱
shots.scene: 包装箱侧面印着空白的开箱示意图
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the side of the box printed with a simple two-step unboxing diagram made of arrows and outlines. No people.
shots.narration: 开箱前，先看箱子上的开箱提示。
overlay: 看开箱提示：先开盖，再侧拉外箱

shots.section_title: 看开箱提示：先开盖，再侧拉外箱
shots.scene: 老李先掀开顶盖，再从侧面把外箱拉开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts off the top lid, then pulls the box sides apart from the side and lifts the enclosure away.
shots.narration: 先打开顶盖，再从侧面拉开，取下外箱。

shots.section_title: 先取焊枪，再取泡沫和主机
shots.scene: 泡沫里放着盘好的焊枪线缆，老李先取出焊枪
shots.prompt_en: Inside the foam packing lies a coiled welding gun cable; the facility engineer lifts out the welding gun first.
shots.narration: 先把焊枪取出来，再拿走泡沫。
overlay: 先取焊枪，再取泡沫和主机

shots.section_title: 先取焊枪，再取泡沫和主机
shots.scene: 老李和阿杰一起把主机从托盘上抬下来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the young male student lift the wheeled main unit off the pallet together.
shots.narration: 主机从托盘上搬下来。

shots.section_title: 先取焊枪，再取泡沫和主机
shots.scene: 线缆绕在主机侧面，焊枪挂在挂架上
shots.prompt_en: The cable is wound on the side of the main unit and the welding gun hangs on its holder. No people.
shots.narration: 线缆绕在主机侧面，焊枪挂好。

shots.section_title: 认识主机和送丝机的部件
shots.scene: 主机正面：触摸屏、急停、指示灯和几个接口
shots.prompt_en: Front view of the blank gray main unit: a touch screen on top, a red emergency stop button, a status light and a column of small ports. No people.
shots.narration: 认识一下主机正面：屏幕、急停、指示灯，
overlay: 认识主机和送丝机的部件

shots.section_title: 认识主机和送丝机的部件
shots.scene: 主机背面：电源开关和几个接口
shots.prompt_en: Back view of the main unit: a rocker power switch and several round connector ports. No people.
shots.narration: 背面有电源开关、送丝机和电源接口。

shots.section_title: 认识主机和送丝机的部件
shots.scene: 送丝机正面的按钮和内部的焊丝盘、送丝驱动
shots.prompt_en: A blank wire feeder box with its door open: two buttons on top, a wire spool holder and a drive roller unit inside. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝机上有送丝和回抽键，里面是送丝驱动。

shots.section_title: 主机留散热间隙，锁定脚轮
shots.scene: 主机前后各画出一段空白间隙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the main unit with arrows showing clear space left in front of and behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 主机前后，按说明书留足散热空间。
overlay: 主机留散热间隙，锁定脚轮

shots.section_title: 主机留散热间隙，锁定脚轮
shots.scene: 老李按下脚轮锁
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake lever on a caster wheel.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 示意图：主机经蓝色气管连到气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the main unit connected by a blue gas hose to a gas cylinder with a regulator. No people.
shots.narration: 接保护气：一根气管连主机和气源。

shots.scene: 老李把气管插进主机的进气口，另一端接到气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes the blue hose into the gas inlet on the main unit, then connects the other end to the cylinder regulator.
shots.narration: 一端插主机进气口，另一端接气瓶或制气机。

shots.scene: 台面上摆着支架底板、两个托架和小螺丝
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a bench with a black base plate, two brackets, small screws and a small hex key. No people.
shots.narration: 组装焊枪支架：底板、托架、螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李用内六角拧好托架，把焊枪放上支架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws the brackets onto the base with the hex key and rests the welding gun on the finished cradle.
shots.narration: 拧好螺丝，焊枪放在支架上。

shots.scene: 老李把感应线插头插进主机的对应接口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs the workpiece sensing cable into its matching port on the main unit.
shots.narration: 工件感应线插进对应的接口。

shots.section_title: 电源要求：单独支路，必须接地
shots.scene: 电源线旁浮现电压、功率、电流三个空白标签
shots.prompt_en: A heavy power cable with three blank tags floating beside it showing only a voltage symbol, a power symbol and a current symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 这台设备功率大，电源要符合说明书要求。
overlay: 电源要求：单独支路，必须接地

shots.section_title: 电源要求：单独支路，必须接地
shots.scene: 配电箱里一条单独的线路连到设备插座
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single dedicated circuit line runs from a distribution box to the machine's socket. No people.
shots.narration: 最好用单独的供电线路。

shots.section_title: 电源要求：单独支路，必须接地
shots.scene: 接地符号亮起打勾
shots.prompt_en: A protective earth symbol lights up with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电源一定要可靠接地。

shots.section_title: 硬接线由专业电工完成
shots.scene: 老李戴着电工证，在配电箱前接线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing a blank electrician badge, works at an open distribution box.
shots.narration: 需要硬接线的，必须由专业电工来做。
overlay: 硬接线由专业电工完成

shots.section_title: 硬接线由专业电工完成
shots.scene: 学生拿着电线自己接的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a student wiring a cable into a box by himself, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不能自己动手接电源线。

shots.scene: 圆形插头和插座针脚放大对比，大针脚朝上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up comparison of a round plug and socket, the larger pin facing upward, with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 圆形插头对准主机插座，大针脚朝上。

shots.scene: 老李插好插头，拧紧锁紧环
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pushes in the round plug and twists its locking ring tight.
shots.narration: 插到位，再拧紧锁紧环。

shots.scene: 老李旋转急停按钮，按钮弹起
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer twists the red emergency stop button and it pops up.
shots.narration: 开机前，确认急停按钮已经旋转释放。

shots.scene: 老李把钥匙插进主机正面的钥匙口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inserts a small key plug into the key port on the front of the main unit.
shots.narration: 把钥匙插进指定的接口。

shots.scene: 老李按下背面的电源开关，屏幕亮起
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer flips the rocker power switch on the back and the touch screen lights up.
shots.narration: 打开背面电源开关，启动设备。

shots.scene: 触摸屏上一排空白的语言方块
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen shows a grid of blank language buttons; a finger taps one. No people.
shots.narration: 在屏幕上选好语言和单位。

shots.section_title: 首次开机：看安全培训再解锁
shots.scene: 屏幕上出现一个二维码图案
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen shows a simple square code pattern and a blank text area. No people.
shots.narration: 第一次开机，屏幕会出现一个二维码。
overlay: 首次开机：看安全培训再解锁

shots.section_title: 首次开机：看安全培训再解锁
shots.scene: 阿杰用手机扫码，手机上播放空白视频
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scans the code with his phone; the phone screen shows a blank video player with a shield icon.
shots.narration: 扫码先看完安全培训视频。

shots.section_title: 首次开机：看安全培训再解锁
shots.scene: 老李在屏幕上输入一串遮住的密码，锁图标打开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer enters a hidden code shown as dots on the touch screen; a padlock icon opens.
shots.narration: 再按提示获取密码，输入后解锁设备。

shots.section_title: 首次开机：看安全培训再解锁
shots.scene: 欣欣点头，旁边是学校培训证书图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods beside a blank training certificate icon.
shots.narration: 厂家培训之外，学校的准入培训也要过。

shots.scene: 屏幕设置页里一个空白数值框被放大
shots.prompt_en: The settings page on the touch screen with one blank value box magnified by a circle. No people.
shots.narration: 在系统设置里，查看焦距刻度参考值。

shots.scene: 焊枪刻度管特写，老李打开卡扣推拉
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the welding gun's graduated tube; the facility engineer opens the clamp and slides the tube.
shots.narration: 刻度管不一致，就打开卡扣推拉到参考值。

shots.scene: 送丝机推到主机左侧，老李锁好脚轮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rolls the wire feeder to the left side of the main unit and locks its casters.
shots.narration: 送丝机只在焊接时用，放在主机左边锁好。

shots.scene: 电缆两端接头一样，凸起朝上插入，拧紧
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs the feeder cable in with the small key facing up and screws the metal collar tight.
shots.narration: 电缆两头一样，凸起朝上插进去，拧紧。

shots.scene: 送丝轮外侧刻着空白规格标记，与焊丝盘对照
shots.prompt_en: A drive roller with a blank size mark on its outer side held next to a wire spool, an equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝轮外侧的尺寸，要和焊丝直径一致。

shots.scene: 老李松开送丝驱动，拆螺丝换上送丝轮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the drive unit, removes the screws and fits the drive rollers, then refastens the screws.
shots.narration: 松开送丝驱动，拆螺丝，装轮，拧回。

shots.scene: 另一对送丝轮放在驱动上方的存放位
shots.prompt_en: The spare pair of drive rollers is stored on the pegs above the drive unit. No people.
shots.narration: 另一对送丝轮放在上方存好。

shots.scene: 老李把送丝管的一端插进送丝机出口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inserts the plain end of the wire feeding tube into the outlet of the wire feeder.
shots.narration: 合上右压紧器，送丝管插进送丝机。

shots.scene: 老李拧紧侧面螺丝，再打开压紧器
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the side screw to hold the tube nozzle in place, then opens the tensioner again.
shots.narration: 导嘴顶到位后拧紧螺丝，再打开压紧器。

shots.scene: 老李拧下盖子，把焊丝盘套到转轴上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unscrews the cap, removes the sleeve and slides a wire spool onto the spindle, aligning the hole with the pin.
shots.narration: 拧下盖子取下套筒，孔对准销装焊丝盘。

shots.scene: 示意图：焊丝从盘的下方引出，进入送丝驱动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an arrow shows the wire leaving from the bottom of the spool and running into the drive unit. No people.
shots.narration: 方向要对：焊丝从盘的下方出来。

shots.section_title: 引丝：不松手，剪弯头，穿丝
shots.scene: 松开的焊丝弹开散乱的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a released wire end springing loose and unraveling from the spool, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 引出焊丝时捏住，一松手就会散开。
overlay: 引丝：不松手，剪弯头，穿丝

shots.section_title: 引丝：不松手，剪弯头，穿丝
shots.scene: 老李用钳子剪掉焊丝弯曲的端头
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer snips off the bent end of the wire with pliers, holding the wire firmly.
shots.narration: 用自备的钳子，剪掉弯曲的端头。

shots.section_title: 引丝：不松手，剪弯头，穿丝
shots.scene: 老李捏住焊丝，穿过送丝轮进入送丝管
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pinches the wire and threads it through the drive rollers into the feeding tube.
shots.narration: 捏住焊丝穿进去，穿过送丝轮进入送丝管。

shots.scene: 老李合上压紧器，旋转红色旋钮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the tensioners and turns their red knobs.
shots.narration: 合上压紧器，转旋钮调送丝压力。

shots.scene: 一张空白表格，行列只有圆点
shots.prompt_en: A blank adjustment table made of empty rows and columns with dots. No people.
shots.narration: 压力大小按说明书的表格来调。

shots.scene: 老李按住送丝机上的送丝键，焊丝盘转动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses and holds the feed button on the wire feeder; the spool turns steadily.
shots.narration: 按住送丝键，焊丝盘匀速转动。

shots.scene: 焊丝从导嘴伸出，老李松手；过长就按回抽
shots.prompt_en: The wire tip appears from the nozzle and he releases the button; a retract button icon is shown beside it.
shots.narration: 丝从导嘴伸出就停，过长按回抽。

shots.section_title: 送丝管装到焊枪，微调焊丝
shots.scene: 老李把送丝管卡在焊枪头上，焊丝从焊嘴槽里伸出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slides the wire feeding tube clamp onto the welding gun tip; the wire comes out through the groove of the nozzle.
shots.narration: 送丝管卡到焊枪头，丝从焊嘴槽里出来。
overlay: 送丝管装到焊枪，微调焊丝

shots.section_title: 送丝管装到焊枪，微调焊丝
shots.scene: 焊枪背面的送丝、回抽键和使能开关
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the back of the welding gun handle with small feed and retract buttons and an on-off switch. No people.
shots.narration: 用焊枪上的送丝回抽键微调长度。

shots.section_title: 送丝管装到焊枪，微调焊丝
shots.scene: 老李固定好送丝管，把焊枪放回支架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer secures the feeding tube along the gun cable and places the gun back on the cradle.
shots.narration: 固定好送丝管，焊枪放回支架。

shots.scene: 六个蓝色防护图标：眼镜、面罩、口罩、手套、衣服、围裙
shots.prompt_en: Six round blue mandatory signs: laser goggles, a welding face shield, a respirator, gloves, work clothes and an apron. No people.
shots.narration: 开始焊接前，按安全说明穿戴防护。

shots.scene: 排风设备开着，空气流动的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A fume extraction unit running near the welding table, with airflow arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 工作间要通风良好。

shots.section_title: 装流量计，先通气调流量
shots.scene: 气瓶减压阀上装着一个流量计
shots.prompt_en: A gas cylinder regulator fitted with a clear tube flow meter. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接前，气瓶或制气机上装好流量计。
overlay: 装流量计，先通气调流量

shots.section_title: 装流量计，先通气调流量
shots.scene: 屏幕上出光开关为关闭状态，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen shows the laser enable toggle in the off position, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确认出光使能是关闭的。

shots.section_title: 装流量计，先通气调流量
shots.scene: 老李开气瓶阀，按住握持键和扳机，调流量计
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the cylinder valve, holds the grip button and trigger, and adjusts the flow meter knob.
shots.narration: 开气瓶阀，按住按键通气，同时调流量。

shots.section_title: 装流量计，先通气调流量
shots.scene: 欣欣指着空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank instruction manual.
shots.narration: 流量数值按说明书设定。

shots.section_title: 工件放金属底座，感应线别夹焊枪
shots.scene: 工件夹在金属台钳上，感应线夹在台钳上
shots.prompt_en: A metal workpiece is clamped in a metal bench vise; the sensing cable clip is attached to the vise. No people.
shots.narration: 工件放在金属底座上，感应线夹在工件上。
overlay: 工件放金属底座，感应线别夹焊枪

shots.section_title: 工件放金属底座，感应线别夹焊枪
shots.scene: 感应线夹在焊枪刻度管上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of the sensing cable clip attached to the graduated tube of the welding gun, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 严禁夹在焊枪的刻度管上。

shots.scene: 丝尖和红点重合，打勾；红点偏在一边，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two close-ups side by side: the wire tip exactly on a small red dot with a green check, and the red dot off to one side with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 调焊丝长短，让丝尖正好落在红点上。

shots.scene: 红点模糊不清的图标，旁边一个扳手
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a blurred faint red dot with a small wrench symbol beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 红点偏了、看不清，先做校准。

shots.scene: 欣欣用手遮在眼前，示意不要盯着红光看
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a paw in front of its eyes as a gesture not to stare at a small red light.
shots.narration: 定位红光功率小，也不要直视。

shots.scene: 眼睛凑近焊嘴看红光的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an eye close to the welding nozzle staring at the red light, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看红点看工件表面，别往焊嘴里看。

shots.scene: 对红点时屏幕出光开关关闭，打勾
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen shows the laser enable toggle off while the red dot is being aligned, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 对红点、校准时，出光使能保持关闭。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊枪上的送丝使能开关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer flips the wire feeding enable switch on the welding gun to on.
shots.narration: 打开焊枪上的送丝使能开关。

shots.scene: 屏幕上选焊接模式、材料、厚度、焊丝直径
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps blank option buttons on the touch screen: mode, material, thickness and wire size.
shots.narration: 屏幕上选焊接模式、材料、厚度和丝径，

shots.scene: 屏幕上两个开关依次打开
shots.prompt_en: Two blank toggles on the touch screen switch on one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 再开启送丝使能和出光使能。

shots.section_title: 先点焊后连续焊，稳住不下压
shots.scene: 老李戴面罩，焊嘴对准起点，按键焊接
shots.prompt_en: Wearing a laser face shield and gloves, the facility engineer aims the nozzle at the start of the seam and presses the grip button and trigger.
shots.narration: 焊嘴对准起点，按住握持键和扳机焊接。
overlay: 先点焊后连续焊，稳住不下压

shots.section_title: 先点焊后连续焊，稳住不下压
shots.scene: 焊缝两端先出现两个点，再连成一条线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two weld dots appear at both ends of a seam, then a continuous weld line joins them. No people.
shots.narration: 先点焊起点和终点，再连续焊。

shots.section_title: 先点焊后连续焊，稳住不下压
shots.scene: 焊枪被向后推的箭头，老李稳住手腕
shots.prompt_en: An arrow shows the welding gun being pushed backward by the reaction force while the facility engineer keeps his wrist steady.
shots.narration: 焊枪会被往后推，稳住，只管引导方向。

shots.section_title: 先点焊后连续焊，稳住不下压
shots.scene: 焊枪用力往下压的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a welding gun being pressed hard down onto the workpiece, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要往下压，免得粘丝。

shots.section_title: 先点焊后连续焊，稳住不下压
shots.scene: 工件用台钳夹住，老李的另一只手远离焊缝
shots.prompt_en: The workpiece is held by a bench vise and the facility engineer's free hand rests far away from the seam.
shots.narration: 工件用夹具固定，手不扶工件。

shots.section_title: 焊后高温别碰，关闭使能
shots.scene: 焊好的工件冒着热气，旁边高温警示
shots.prompt_en: A freshly welded workpiece gives off heat waves with a hot surface warning sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 焊完的工件和焊枪头很烫，别直接碰。
overlay: 焊后高温别碰，关闭使能

shots.section_title: 焊后高温别碰，关闭使能
shots.scene: 屏幕上两个开关关闭
shots.prompt_en: Two toggles on the touch screen switch off. No people.
shots.narration: 关闭送丝使能和出光使能。

shots.scene: 老李关机，拆下送丝管和焊嘴，换上清洗嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine, removes the feeding tube and welding nozzle, and fits a cleaning nozzle.
shots.narration: 激光清洗：先关机，换上清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 老李开机，在屏幕上选清洗并开启出光
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the machine on and taps a cleaning option and the laser enable toggle on the screen.
shots.narration: 开机，选清洗，开出光，确认。

shots.scene: 焊枪与焊缝平行，沿焊缝移动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds the welding gun parallel to the weld seam and moves it along the seam.
shots.narration: 焊枪和焊缝平行，按键沿焊缝清洗。

shots.section_title: 激光切割：换嘴、换表、查红点
shots.scene: 老李记下屏幕上的参考值，关机换切割嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer writes down a value from the screen, switches off and fits a pointed cutting nozzle.
shots.narration: 激光切割：记下刻度参考值，关机换切割嘴。
overlay: 激光切割：换嘴、换表、查红点

shots.section_title: 激光切割：换嘴、换表、查红点
shots.scene: 气瓶上的流量计换成带两个压力表的减压阀
shots.prompt_en: On the gas cylinder, the flow meter is replaced by a regulator with two pressure gauges. No people.
shots.narration: 气瓶上换成带减压阀的压力表。

shots.section_title: 激光切割：换嘴、换表、查红点
shots.scene: 清晰的红点打勾，散开的红点打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two close-ups: a sharp round red dot with a green check and a smeared red dot with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 开机看红点清不清晰，不清晰先校准。

shots.section_title: 激光切割：换嘴、换表、查红点
shots.scene: 老李调减压阀，再在屏幕上选切割
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer adjusts the regulator knob, then taps a cutting option on the touch screen.
shots.narration: 气压按说明书调好，选切割，开出光。

shots.section_title: 激光切割：换嘴、换表、查红点
shots.scene: 切割时火花向下飞溅，下方没有杂物
shots.prompt_en: Sparks fly downward from the cut on the metal table; the floor below is clear of any objects. No people.
shots.narration: 开始切割，火花方向不能有人和杂物。

shots.scene: 两种规格的铜导嘴并排，各对一卷焊丝
shots.prompt_en: Two brass wire feeding nozzles of different sizes side by side, each paired with a matching wire spool. No people.
shots.narration: 送丝导嘴有不同规格，按焊丝直径换。

shots.section_title: 镜片脏了：干净环境里处理
shots.scene: 焊接火花变弱的对比图
shots.prompt_en: Two side-by-side icons: a bright strong weld spark and a weak dim spark with a down arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接火花变弱，可能是保护镜片脏了。
overlay: 镜片脏了：干净环境里处理

shots.section_title: 镜片脏了：干净环境里处理
shots.scene: 老李在干净的台面上，用无尘布擦焊枪外壳
shots.prompt_en: At a clean bench, the facility engineer wipes the welding gun housing with a lint-free cloth.
shots.narration: 在干净的地方操作，先把焊枪擦干净。

shots.section_title: 镜片脏了：干净环境里处理
shots.scene: 老李洗手后戴上蓝色无尘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer washes his hands and puts on blue lint-free nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 洗手或戴无尘手套。

shots.scene: 老李拆下焊枪顶部的小盖，取出镜片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the small cover on top of the welding gun and pulls out the lens protector holder.
shots.narration: 拆下焊枪顶盖，取出保护镜片。

shots.scene: 老李用棉签轻擦镜片
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently wipes the lens protector with a cotton swab.
shots.narration: 脏了用棉签蘸少量酒精擦净，装回。

shots.scene: 烧焦发黑的镜片图标，旁边换新箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a burned dark lens protector with an arrow pointing to a new clear lens. No people.
shots.narration: 烧坏了、擦不干净的，就要更换。

shots.section_title: 换镜片不碰玻璃，方向装对
shots.scene: 手指碰镜片玻璃的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a finger touching the glass of a lens protector, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 换新镜片时，手指和工具都别碰玻璃。
overlay: 换镜片不碰玻璃，方向装对

shots.section_title: 换镜片不碰玻璃，方向装对
shots.scene: 老李撕掉镜片一面保护膜，装进镜座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels the protective film off one side of a new lens and fits it into the holder.
shots.narration: 撕一面保护膜装进去，再撕另一面。

shots.section_title: 换镜片不碰玻璃，方向装对
shots.scene: 老李装回垫圈，按方向把镜座插回焊枪
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refits the gasket and pushes the lens holder back into the welding gun in the correct direction.
shots.narration: 装回垫圈，方向装对，压到位。

shots.scene: 红点偏在焊丝一侧的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view: the red dot falls to one side of the wire tip instead of on it. No people.
shots.narration: 焊嘴装好了，红点仍偏在焊丝一边，

shots.scene: 老李在屏幕上点左右箭头，红点移到焊丝上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer taps left and right arrows on a settings screen; the red dot moves onto the wire.
shots.narration: 在设置里点左右箭头，把红点调到焊丝上。

shots.scene: 屏幕上一个带锁的设置入口，钥匙在老李手里
shots.prompt_en: A settings entry with a padlock icon on the touch screen; the facility engineer holds a key symbol.
shots.narration: 这项设置需要管理员权限，由负责人操作。

shots.scene: 切割嘴里光打到内壁的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: inside a narrow cutting nozzle, the beam hits the inner wall instead of passing through the center. No people.
shots.narration: 用切割嘴时，光可能打到喷嘴内壁。

shots.scene: 老李用小内六角慢慢拧焊枪上的调节孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer slowly turns a small hex key in an adjustment hole on the welding gun while watching the nozzle.
shots.narration: 先调左右；还不行，用内六角慢慢调上下。

shots.scene: 喷嘴下出现一个清晰的红点，老李停手
shots.prompt_en: A clear round red dot appears below the nozzle and the facility engineer stops turning. No people.
shots.narration: 看到清晰的红点就停。

shots.scene: 一细一粗两卷焊丝，中间一个箭头
shots.prompt_en: Two wire spools, one thinner and one thicker, with an arrow from the first to the second. No people.
shots.narration: 换更粗的焊丝，步骤是这样的。

shots.scene: 老李打开压紧器，倒转焊丝盘把丝退出来
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the tensioners and turns the spool backward to pull the wire out of the drive unit.
shots.narration: 打开压紧器，倒转焊丝盘，把丝退出来。

shots.scene: 焊丝端头弯折插进焊丝盘的小孔
shots.prompt_en: The wire end is bent and tucked into a small hole on the rim of the spool. No people.
shots.narration: 丝头弯好插进盘边小孔，取下存放。

shots.scene: 老李换上一对新的送丝轮，核对外侧尺寸
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer fits a new pair of drive rollers and checks the size mark on their outer side.
shots.narration: 换上尺寸对应的送丝轮和导嘴。

shots.scene: 老李装新焊丝盘，剪弯头，穿丝，调压力
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer mounts the new spool, snips the bent end, threads the wire and adjusts the tension knobs.
shots.narration: 装新盘、剪弯头、穿丝、调压力。

shots.scene: 按住送丝键，焊丝从导嘴伸出
shots.prompt_en: The feed button is held down and the new wire comes out of the nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 按住送丝键，送到导嘴伸出为止。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在装好的焊接机旁，身后四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the set-up laser welding machine with four icons floating behind: a box, a wrench, a welding gun and a gear.
shots.narration: 开箱有顺序，接电找电工，开机先培训。

shots.scene: 图标：夹具、红点、镜片、焊丝盘
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row: a bench vise, a red dot, a lens and a wire spool. No people.
shots.narration: 工件夹牢，红点对准，镜片干净，焊丝对号。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着工作服和劳保鞋，向镜头竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, now in a cotton work suit, cap and safety boots, gives a thumbs up.
shots.narration: 阿杰的打扮，终于像个焊工了。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside the machine.
shots.narration: 装得规范，用得安心。下次见！
